independence_instructions: Use only the public, answer-free task, scenario, metric, qualification, and overlay evidence listed in the review worksheet.
Do not inspect the gold production patch, reference solution, hidden tests, or model-generated implementation.
Judge semantic naturalness yourself; automated qualification is evidence, not inclusion authority.

Complete annotator_id, include, parallelizability_label, rationale, and exclusion_reason as applicable.
rationale: This task is suitable for AsynCodeBench because the shared TVMScript AST, parser, and document-printer core is a natural producer for two distinct consumers: Relax dependent signatures and TIRx dependent signatures. Each consumer must preserve the shared type-parameter representation, declared symbolic-variable order, constraints, and parse-print round trip. Public fan-out ablations show the core-only state passing 1/3 focused selectors, core plus either consumer passing 2/3 while the sibling remains red, and complete integration passing 3/3; the selected regression evaluator reports 501 passes and two expected failures. In private asynchronous work, either dialect can consume an older document shape, omit type parameters, or reorder symbolic variables, creating a stale shared-API failure that appears only during integrated round trips. The two consumers can progress in parallel after agreeing on the core contract, so partially_parallelizable is the appropriate label.
